games.title: Counter-Strike 2
games.notes: Source 2 engine is heavily CPU single-thread and memory-latency sensitive. SSD eliminates map stutter.
games.compromiseTips: Disable MSAA or use CMAA2, set Particle Detail to Low, set 1080p with Reflex Enabled.

games.title: Valorant
games.notes: Engineered for exceptional low-end performance. Easily reaches 144+ FPS on modest modern CPUs.
games.compromiseTips: Run 1080p Low settings. Turn off Bloom and Distortion.

games.title: Apex Legends
games.notes: Fast-paced Battle Royale. Dynamic action demands stable 60+ FPS to aim reliably.
games.compromiseTips: Lower Adaptive Resolution Target to 60, set Texture Streaming Budget to 2GB or 3GB.

games.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
games.notes: Uses Vulkan API which grants significant boost to budget AMD/Intel graphics.
games.compromiseTips: Use the Vulkan launcher executable and enable Dynamic Render Scaling.

games.title: Overwatch 2
games.notes: Extremely well-optimized engine with native FSR 2.2 and Nvidia Reflex support.
games.compromiseTips: Enable AMD FSR at 75% render scale for an instant 35% framerate boost.

games.title: Team Fortress 2
games.notes: Vintage classic. Runs on virtually any computer made in the last 15 years.
games.compromiseTips: Uses DirectX 9. Install Mastercomfig for ultra-smooth frametimes on older laptops.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077 (Phantom Liberty)
games.notes: Mandatory SSD requirement. Highly multithreaded; demands dedicated GPU with minimum 6GB VRAM.
games.compromiseTips: Use DLSS / FSR Balanced mode, set Crowd Density to Medium, turn Screen Space Reflections to Low.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.notes: Locked to 60 FPS cap. Open world shader compilation requires 12GB+ RAM for hitch-free play.
games.compromiseTips: Lower Shadow Quality and Volumetric Effects to Medium. Keep resolution at native 1080p.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.notes: Act 3 city area is heavily CPU single/multi-thread bound. Huge 150GB footprint requires fast storage.
games.compromiseTips: Switch to Vulkan API on AMD GPUs or DX11 on Nvidia. Cap framerate at 40 or 45 FPS.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.notes: Remarkably scalable engine. Runs smoothly on modern Iris Xe / Radeon 780M iGPUs at 1080p.
games.compromiseTips: Disable Grass Quality (set to Normal) and turn off Advanced Graphics section completely.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (Next-Gen)
games.notes: Can be launched in legacy DirectX 11 mode for a huge performance boost on older hardware.
games.compromiseTips: Choose DirectX 11 in launcher to bypass heavy DX12 overhead on older GPUs.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.notes: Graphically demanding western epic with lush foliage and volumetric cloud simulation.
games.compromiseTips: Use Hardware Unboxed optimized settings preset: Volumetrics Medium, Water Physics 50%.

games.title: Genshin Impact
games.notes: Anime action RPG. Runs solidly on modern integrated graphics (Iris Xe / Vega 7) at 1080p Medium.
games.compromiseTips: Set Render Resolution to 1.0 or 0.8, SFX to Medium, SMAA anti-aliasing.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.notes: Very friendly to entry-level hardware in vanilla unmodded state. Heavy mods multiply requirements.
games.compromiseTips: Disable Godrays and turn Screen Space Ambient Occlusion to Low.

games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.notes: Stellar PC port with built-in dynamic optimization and benchmark utility.
games.compromiseTips: Enable Dynamic Optimization at 60 FPS target; the game auto-adjusts LOD on the fly.

games.title: Rocket League
games.notes: Unreal Engine 3 sports vehicular soccer. Reaches 120+ FPS on budget machines easily.
games.compromiseTips: Set Render Quality to High Performance, turn off Bloom and Motion Blur.

games.title: F1 23 / F1 24
games.notes: Requires responsive physics handling. Wheel setups benefit from rock-solid 60+ FPS.
games.compromiseTips: Disable Ray Tracing, set Weather Effects to Medium, use DLSS/FSR in Performance mode.

games.title: Assetto Corsa
games.notes: Dedicated physics simulation. Highly moddable via Content Manager and Custom Shaders Patch.
games.compromiseTips: Vanilla game runs smoothly on Intel Iris Xe; use Content Manager to cap smoke density.

games.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
games.notes: CPU speed directly dictates turn processing time in late-game with 12+ civilizations.
games.compromiseTips: Enable Strategic View during large AI end-turn calculations to bypass 3D rendering.

games.title: Stellaris
games.notes: Not GPU heavy at all, but end-game pop simulation will lag older dual-core CPUs.
games.compromiseTips: Select Medium or Small galaxy sizes and set Habitable Worlds slider to 0.75x.

games.title: Hearts of Iron IV
games.notes: WWII grand strategy. 1944+ world war ticks depend heavily on high CPU IPC.
games.compromiseTips: Disable 3D buildings, reflections, and weather effects in video settings.

games.title: Total War: WARHAMMER III
games.notes: Massive battlefield units test CPU physics while campaign map pushes GPU VRAM.
games.compromiseTips: Reduce Unit Size to Large or Medium instead of Ultra, turn 3D UI Porter to 2D.

games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
games.notes: One of the most demanding simulators ever built. 16GB RAM is the true practical baseline.
games.compromiseTips: Cap at 30 or 40 FPS, set Terrain Level of Detail to 80, enable DLSS/FSR Quality.

games.title: Cities: Skylines II
games.notes: Extreme geometry complexity. Known heavy performance demands even on high-end rigs.
games.compromiseTips: Turn Volumetric Fog Quality completely OFF, disable Motion Blur and Depth of Field.

games.title: RimWorld
games.notes: Colony sim masterpiece. Runs on any potato PC. Heavily CPU single-core dependent on large colonies.
games.compromiseTips: Vanilla runs smoothly everywhere. Limit pawn colony count to 15 if on low-end hardware.

games.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
games.notes: Relaxing road simulation with updated lighting engine. Runs well on modern laptops.
games.compromiseTips: Set Mirror Quality to Medium and Scaling to 100% instead of 200% or 300%.

games.title: Minecraft (Java & Bedrock)
games.notes: Java Edition is famously CPU-bound. Installing the Sodium / Lithium mod triples framerates on laptops.
games.compromiseTips: Install Fabric + Sodium mod loader. Reduce render distance from 16 to 10 chunks.

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.notes: Comfortable farming simulator that runs beautifully on virtually any computer.
games.compromiseTips: Runs at 60 FPS out of the box with zero compromises needed.

games.title: Terraria
games.notes: 2D sandbox adventure. Tiny system requirements, limitless hours of progression.
games.compromiseTips: Turn Frame Skip to On or Subtle to keep internal physics synced.

games.title: Balatro
games.notes: Roguelike poker deckbuilder. Extremely lightweight 2D Love2D engine with zero battery drain.
games.compromiseTips: Runs at maximum fidelity and 60 FPS on any machine.

games.title: Hades II
games.notes: Fluid mythological roguelike with gorgeous hand-drawn art and buttery 60 FPS action.
games.compromiseTips: Runs smoothly on Intel Iris Xe and Vega 7 iGPUs at native 1080p.

games.title: Lethal Company
games.notes: Viral co-op horror. Low poly aesthetic makes it very accessible for friend groups.
games.compromiseTips: Use HDLethalCompany mod if you want to upscale, or keep vanilla for budget rigs.

games.title: Palworld
games.notes: Unreal Engine 5 creature survival. High memory usage; 16GB RAM is strongly advised.
games.compromiseTips: Set Foliage and Shadows to Low, enable TSR or FSR upscaling.

games.title: Black Myth: Wukong
games.notes: Unreal Engine 5 with full Lumen and TSR/FSR/DLSS. Mandatory SSD for fluid asset streaming.
games.compromiseTips: Use TSR or FSR at 65% render resolution with Frame Generation enabled on compatible GPUs.

games.title: Helldivers 2
games.notes: Intense swarm physics and particle explosions can heavily stress multi-core CPUs during extraction.
games.compromiseTips: Lower Volumetric Fog and Space Quality to Medium; enable Native resolution scaling.

games.title: Minecraft (Java & Bedrock)
games.notes: Bedrock edition is extraordinarily light; Java edition benefits heavily from Sodium and Lithium performance mods.
games.compromiseTips: Install the Fabric Sodium optimization mod for a 300% framerate increase on any laptop or budget PC.

games.title: Roblox
games.notes: Scales to almost any mobile phone, tablet, or entry PC. Uncapped framerate available via settings.
games.compromiseTips: Lower Graphics Quality slider to 3 or 4 for locked 60 FPS on integrated graphics.

games.title: Fortnite (Battle Royale)
games.notes: Features a dedicated "Performance Mode" that drops draw overhead for 144+ FPS on budget machines.
games.compromiseTips: Switch Rendering API to Performance (Alpha) in video settings for buttery smooth 100+ FPS.

games.title: Call of Duty: Warzone / MW3
games.notes: Demands dual-channel RAM and high memory bandwidth. Strongly optimized with FidelityFX CAS and DLSS.
games.compromiseTips: Enable FidelityFX CAS at 75% sharpening and set Spot Cache to Ultra to stop hitching.

games.title: God of War (PC)
games.notes: Exemplary PC port with native support for DLSS, FSR 2.0, and 21:9 ultrawide monitors.
games.compromiseTips: Use FSR 2.0 Quality setting and reduce Shadow Resolution to Original for 50-60 FPS on GTX 1060.

games.title: Hogwarts Legacy
games.notes: Heavy asset streaming inside Hogwarts castle; 16GB RAM and SSD are essential to prevent frame drops.
games.compromiseTips: Set Fog Quality and Post Processing to Medium; enable FSR 2 Balanced.

games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.notes: Masterclass in engine optimization. Runs at 60+ FPS on mid-range hardware with gorgeous open-world vistas.
games.compromiseTips: Use Dynamic Optimization set to 60 FPS or enable FSR 2.2 Quality mode.
